import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    if data.empty:
        normalized_data = pd.DataFrame(index=data.index, columns=data.columns, dtype=float)
        normalized_data['Average'] = normalized_data.mean(axis=1)
        fig, ax = plt.subplots()
        if not normalized_data['Average'].empty:
            normalized_data['Average'].plot(kind='bar', ax=ax)
        return normalized_data, ax

    scaler = MinMaxScaler()
    normalized_array = scaler.fit_transform(data)
    normalized_data = pd.DataFrame(normalized_array, columns=data.columns, index=data.index)
    
    normalized_data['Average'] = normalized_data.mean(axis=1)
    
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    normalized_data['Average'].plot(kind='bar', ax=ax)
    
    return normalized_data, ax
